name: fmp_available_industries
description:
Industry names FMP uses to classify companies, from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP).
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/available-industries as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): none.
Use the values as the industry filter of fmp_stock_screener; sectors: fmp_available_sectors.
Example: {}
